svg.metadata: {"id": "s058", "name": "稻田插秧", "cat": "艺术与劳动", "tags": ["劳动", "农业", "二十四节气", "粮食"], "desc": "春天的水田插秧：远山与梯田，水面倒映天空，左半边已插好整齐的秧苗行，右半边还是水面，田埂上放着秧把、斗笠和竹篮，白鹭与燕子。", "stand": {"ground_y": 900, "x": [540, 1380]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.2, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "mountains", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.2, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "terraces", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.3, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "willows", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.4, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "paddy", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "ripples", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "flow", "depth": null}, {"name": "seedlings", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.5, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "ridge", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "tools", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "egrets", "enter": "pop", "delay": 1.0, "loop": "bob", "depth": null}, {"name": "swallows", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 1.1, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#A8DDF5", "sky2": "#F3FAEE", "sun": "#FFE08A", "m1": "#B9DCCB", "m2": "#96C9AE", "m3": "#77B592", "terr1": "#BFE2A2", "terr2": "#A3D486", "terr3": "#8CC56E", "water": "#BFE5EE", "water2": "#A3D6E4", "water3": "#D9F1F4", "seed": "#5DB25A", "seed2": "#9AD86E", "ridge": "#9BC774", "ridge2": "#7FAE5A", "mud": "#B08A62", "hat": "#E9C87C", "hat2": "#C9A458", "basket": "#C99A5E", "basket2": "#A67A44", "bird": "#FFFFFF", "beak": "#F2B33D", "willow": "#7DBF6A", "willow2": "#A9D98A", "trunk": "#8A6A4A", "swallow": "#2F3B4E"}}
